operations.read: canonical Markdown documentation and primary paper/author-repository web pages
operations.performed: literal analytic reasoning; temporary draft creation

candidates.name: AST-specific distinguishing portfolio synthesis
candidates.mechanism: Compile typed ASTs to response grammars; synthesize and shrink event edits; choose a portfolio by zero literal false alarms, fresh mutant phenotypes killed and comparison cost.
candidates.novelty_status: conditional_new_mechanism; duplicate unless automatic synthesis beats the existing fixed018/045 bank at equal comparison count
candidates.inputs_clock: Synthetic event bag, typed AST, fixed T/source/category context/Q/C; no labels.
candidates.counterhypothesis: Only rediscovers known laws or overfits the same mutant family.
candidates.literal_falsifier: Share1/2 must become2/3 under numerator duplicate and1/3 under denominator-only addition; off-C denominator mutant must be separated.
candidates.baseline: Fixed018/045 and random portfolios with equal comparison ceilings and independent fresh mutants.
candidates.possible_claim: Bounded test-synthesis adequacy/efficiency, no universal correctness or quality claim.

candidates.name: Observation-context conditional gates
candidates.mechanism: Learn sparse context-dependent feature inclusion over valid supported features; deterministic frozen gates and validity companions at inference.
candidates.novelty_status: new selector candidate; contextual usefulness is separate from existing capability masks
candidates.inputs_clock: Pre-T feature values, coverage/support/category known/source capability context; train-only labels for gate/predictor; new prospective reservation.
candidates.counterhypothesis: Strong boosting already learns context interactions; gates add variance or remove rare valid signal.
candidates.literal_falsifier: Context-switching balanced-bit task shows contextual predictiveness but dense tree with same inputs also reaches100%; no expressivity/information claim.
candidates.baseline: Strong boosting with f,z; same dense predictor with f,z; global gates; conditional gates. Four fixed fits, no tuning.
candidates.possible_claim: Conditional sparsification/predictive robustness under specified observation regimes, not cross-dataset or causal validity.

candidates.name: Common-context marginal usefulness criterion
candidates.mechanism: Compare B+f minus B gain under q(z) proportional to p1(z)p2(z), require positive common benefit and bounded discrepancy, abstain outside adequate overlap.
candidates.novelty_status: new decision criterion beyond equal raw temporal risks/distributions; adaptation of WRI, not theorem reproduction
candidates.inputs_clock: Frozen future B/B+f predictions, fullY and pre-T context bins from two prospectively reserved environments.
candidates.counterhypothesis: Coarse bins hide conditional shifts; overlap support is too sparse.
candidates.literal_falsifier: p1=.9/.1,p2=.1/.9,delta=.2/.05 yields raw.185/.065 and common.125/.125; disjoint support must return unknown.
candidates.baseline: Pooled-gain selector and unweighted stability selector on identical artifacts/outcomes/look budget.
candidates.possible_claim: Common-support predictive gain stability for named contexts/dates; no causal or disjoint-population guarantee.

candidates.name: Action-specific least-distortion reversal radius
candidates.mechanism: Use smallest tested history/candidate deletion budget that reverses feature gain as admission criterion, report grid brackets with behavior and sampling radii separate.
candidates.novelty_status: conditional_new_decision_operator; descriptive sensitivity alone merges intoHYP013
candidates.inputs_clock: Future pre-T histories and fixed Q/C/fullY/models; pinned label-blind thinning; no retraining, no exposure assumptions.
candidates.counterhypothesis: Synthetic thinning differs from real observation change; low radius need not forecast failure.
candidates.literal_falsifier: Three K1 queries, two f wins and one B win; label-blind ID deletion of two distractions changes gain+1/3 to-1/3.
candidates.baseline: Clean paired-gain selection using the same model artifacts, seven-case grid and future decision lock.
candidates.possible_claim: Robustness to named synthetic observation/sampling domains; no ground-truth preference, exposure or causal claim.
